title: East-coast gas price cap and Gas Market Code
summary: An emergency price cap of $12/GJ on east-coast wholesale gas applied from 23 December 2022, and the mandatory Gas Market Code, with a reasonable-price provision, from 11 July 2023.

instruments.title: Competition and Consumer (Gas Market Emergency Price) Order 2022
Competition and Consumer (Gas Market Code) Regulations 2023

direction_rationale: Price caps lower input costs for gas users but may deter supply investment and reduce the number of producers competing to supply.
comparison: WA and the NT are outside the east-coast market; gas-intensive versus other manufacturing

assessment.summary: An emergency cap on east-coast wholesale gas prices, then a mandatory code with a 'reasonable price' rule. It lowered input costs for gas users, but controls on the price of a major input dull the signal for new supply and add regulatory risk for investors.

marks.reason: A binding price control in a major input market keeps prices from signalling scarcity.
Price controls and exemptions negotiated case by case add regulatory risk to gas supply investment.
